8358.name: The Castle Yard

north.description: To the north lies The Castle Square.

east.description: To the east lies The Castle Yard.

west.description: To the west lies The Castle Yard.

8358.description:
Black flagstones, cracked and puddled, spread across the lower yard
where the wind off the hills scours the curtain wall. The wall rises
beyond the stones, grim and windowless, streaked with soot. Straw and
dung are ground into the paving, and the smell of horses hangs heavy in
the cold air. The yard opens north toward the Castle Square, while worn
tracks lead east and west along the foot of the wall.

8359.name: The Castle Square

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance To Castle N'Kai.

east.description: To the east lies In Front Of The Stable.

south.description: To the south lies The Castle Yard.

west.description: To the west lies The Castle Yard.

8359.description:
The square is a wide court of black cobbles, hemmed in by the dark bulk
of the castle and a row of low outbuildings. A well with an iron cover
squats at its middle, ringed with hoof-scars and rust. Sentries have
worn a path across the stones, and the smell of horses and old fear
never quite leaves the air. North the great entrance of Castle N'Kai
looms, east lies the stable front, and the yard spreads south and west.

extra_descs.well cover iron:
The well is capped with a heavy iron lid, bolted down and scored with
pale scratches from the inside. Nobody in the castle will say what it
was sealed against.

8360.name: The Castle Yard

north.description: To the north lies In Front Of The Stable.

west.description: To the west lies The Castle Yard.

8360.description:
The yard here is rutted by cart wheels and pocked with puddles skinned
in grey scum. A leaning woodpile and a broken cart sit against the wall,
spokes rotted and axle snapped. Smoke from some hidden chimney smears
the sky. The stable front lies north, and the yard runs on west.

8361.name: In Front Of The Stable

north.description: To the north lies The Castle Yard.

east.description: To the east lies The Stable.

south.description: To the south lies The Castle Yard.

west.description: To the west lies The Castle Square.

8361.description:
The reek of horses is strongest here, rich and sharp, rolling out of the
stable's broad doorway. Manure and trampled straw cake the cobbles, and
a tethering post bristles with gnawed splinters. The stable door stands
east, the castle yard runs north and south, and the square opens west.
Iron rings in the wall show where mounts were once tied and where chains
have since been fitted.

8362.name: The Castle Yard

north.description: To the north lies The Castle Yard.

east.description: To the east lies The Castle Yard.

8362.description:
This corner of the yard is a dump of broken barrels, cracked shields and
rotted crates piled against the wall. Weeds push through the paving in
grey clumps. The air stinks of old urine and mould. The yard continues
north, and east it widens toward the middle.

8363.name: The Castle Yard

north.description: To the north lies The Castle Yard.

east.description: To the east lies The Castle Square.

south.description: To the south lies The Castle Yard.

west.description: To the west lies The Guards' Quarters.

8363.description:
A heavy door in the west wall opens on the guards' quarters, studded
with iron and hung with a drum-tight leather curtain. Before it the
cobbles are chipped by drill-marks and sharp little scrapes of
swordplay. The yard runs north and south, and the square lies east.

8364.name: The Castle Yard

east.description: To the east lies The Entrance To Castle N'Kai.

south.description: To the south lies The Castle Yard.

8364.description:
Here the yard bends toward the keep, and the wall rises sheer on the
other side, hung with the stubs of old chains. A water butt stands green
and stagnant against the stone, and a ring of blackened cobbles shows
where a fire once burned. The castle entrance lies east, and the yard
continues south.

8365.name: The Castle Yard

south.description: To the south lies In Front Of The Stable.

west.description: To the west lies The Entrance To Castle N'Kai.

8365.description:
Hard-packed earth and black cobbles meet along the foot of the keep
wall, trampled to mud where the stable carts turn. A rusted ring is set
in the stone, and a wooden trough stands dry and cracked beside it. The
yard runs south toward the stable front, while the castle entrance lies
west. Above, the parapet cuts a jagged line against the sky.

8366.name: The Entrance To Castle N'Kai

north.description: To the north lies Inside The Castle.

east.description: To the east lies The Castle Yard.

south.description: To the south lies The Castle Square.

west.description: To the west lies The Castle Yard.

8366.description:
A pointed arch of black stone frames the iron-bound doors of Castle
N'Kai, the lintel carved with a ring of leering faces. A door leads
north into the keep, and cold breath from the hall beyond drifts across
the threshold. Torch brackets hang empty and sooty on either side, and
the steps are worn hollow by many boots. The yard curves away east and
west, and the square lies back to the south.

8367.name: The Guards' Quarters

east.description: To the east lies The Castle Yard.

west.description: To the west lies A Barren Room.

8367.description:
Long tables and benches fill a smoky hall that serves the garrison, the
boards carved with dice-games and obscene verses. Weapon racks stand
along the wall, half empty, and the cold hearth is heaped with scorched
bones. A thick haze of pipe-smoke and stale ale clings to the beams. The
door east leads to the yard, and a barren room lies west.

8368.name: The Stable

west.description: To the west lies In Front Of The Stable.

down.description: To the down lies Under The Stable.

8368.description:
Rows of stalls run the length of the stable, their timbers scarred by
hooves and teeth. Hay lies heaped in the lofts, damp and mouldering, and
the whole building trembles faintly with the stamping of unseen weight.
Lanterns hang on hooks, shuttered and black with soot. The yard lies
west through the doors, and a trapdoor in the floor opens on steps
leading down.

8369.name: Under The Stable

up.description: To the up lies The Stable.

8369.description:
A low undercroft of packed earth and rough timbers lies beneath the
stalls, where feed and harness were once stored. Damp trickles between
the stones, and the ceiling drips onto a floor of black mud. Old bridles
and broken tack rot in the corners, and claw marks mar the beams at the
height of a kneeling man. The steps up lead back to the stable.

8370.name: Inside The Castle

north.description: To the north lies The Horrid Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Entrance To Castle N'Kai.

8370.description:
You stand in a vaulted vestibule where the daylight dies a few paces
from the door. The walls are slick black stone hung with moth-eaten
banners whose devices have faded past knowing. A single guttering torch
throws long shadows over a floor scored by iron-shod feet. The door
south returns to the castle entrance, and a narrow passage runs north
into the gloom of the hallway.

8371.name: The Horrid Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Horrid Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies At The Grand Staircase.

south.description: To the south lies Inside The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Corridor.

8371.description:
The hallway earns its name: the walls sweat, the ceiling drips, and
carved gargoyle faces grin from every corbel. A damp, sour smell rises
from the flagstones, and the torchlight seems afraid to reach the
corners. A door to the east opens on the grand staircase, and another to
the west gives onto a small corridor. The hall runs on north, and the
vestibule lies back south.

8372.name: The Horrid Hallway

south.description: To the south lies The Horrid Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Corridor.

8372.description:
Here the hallway bends and dies against a blank wall of black blocks
stained dark by years of seepage. Chains hang from rusted rings set high
in the stone, swaying though no draught can be felt. The floor is gritty
with old plaster fallen from the vault. The hall returns south, and an
open archway leads west into a small corridor.

extra_descs.chains rings:
The chains end in open shackles worn bright on the inside. They are far
too short to have held anything standing.

8373.name: At The Grand Staircase

east.description: To the east lies The Hall Of Guests.

west.description: To the west lies The Horrid Hallway.

up.description: To the up lies The Grand Staircase.

8373.description:
A great stair of black marble sweeps upward from the middle of the hall,
its balustrade carved with twisting serpents. The treads are worn pale
at their centres, and the air above is wreathed in shadow. Beyond the
stair the hall continues east toward the Hall Of Guests, and a door west
leads back to the Horrid Hallway. You may climb up to the landing above.

8374.name: A Small Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Small Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Horrid Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Servants' Quarters.

8374.description:
The corridor narrows to a sliver of dark stone, lit by one rushlight in
a cracked sconce. Scratches are gouged along the wall at the height of a
hand, as though someone was dragged this way. The passage runs north
deeper into the servants' wing and opens east onto the hallway. A heavy
door to the west leads into more servants' quarters.

8375.name: A Small Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Small Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Horrid Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies Servants' Quarters.

8375.description:
A cramped passage of bare stone, the ceiling low enough to make a tall
man stoop. Smoke and grease have blackened the walls, and a worn runner
of sacking muffles every footstep. The corridor continues north and
south along the servants' wing, with the hallway open to the east. A
plank door in the west wall leads into the servants' quarters.

8376.name: A Small Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Kitchen.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies Chamber Of The Cleaning Mistress.

8376.description:
The passage ends in a smoky doorway, and the stink of boiled cabbage and
tallow drifts out of it. A broom, a bucket and a rack of rags stand
against the wall as though they had never been moved. North the kitchen
waits beyond its arch, south the corridor runs back, and a door in the
west wall bears a scrubbed brass plate. The flags underfoot are worn
smooth by endless scouring.

8377.name: The Kitchen

south.description: To the south lies A Small Corridor.

8377.description:
A vast black hearth fills one wall of the kitchen, its spit and chains
thick with old grease. Dented copper pots hang dull from the beams, and
a scarred table bears the marks of a thousand cleavers. The flagstones
are slick, the air is hot and sour, and the smell of boiled bones
lingers over everything. The only way out is the corridor south.

8378.name: Servants' Quarters

east.description: To the east lies A Small Corridor.

8378.description:
Straw pallets crowd the floor of this windowless dormitory, each with a
rolled blanket and a battered wooden bowl. The air is thick with sweat,
tallow and a thin sour note of fear. Names are scratched into the beams,
some crossed out with a hard, deliberate hand. The only door lies east,
back to the corridor.

8379.name: Servants' Quarters

east.description: To the east lies A Small Corridor.

8379.description:
A second dormitory, colder than the first, lies behind the door. Narrow
bunks are stacked three high against the walls, and moth-eaten livery
hangs from nails. A cracked mirror leans against a trunk, showing only a
smear of grey. The distant clatter of the household and a muffled sob
seep through the stone. The way out is east, back into the corridor.

8380.name: Chamber Of The Cleaning Mistress

east.description: To the east lies A Small Corridor.

8380.description:
The mistress of the household keeps a narrow room, spotless in a way
that feels more threatening than welcoming. A cot with a grey blanket
stretched drum-tight stands beneath a window slit, and a ring of iron
keys hangs from a peg. Every shelf is lined with folded linen, scrubbing
brushes and cakes of lye soap. The door east leads back to the corridor.

8381.name: The Hall Of Guests

east.description: To the east lies The Hidden Library.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Stairway.

west.description: To the west lies At The Grand Staircase.

8381.description:
Long tables of dark oak line this hall, set with tarnished plate for
guests who never come. High windows of smoked glass let in a bruised
grey light that never reaches the floor. Tapestries of hunts and
executions cover the walls, their threads rotted at the edges. A
cunningly panelled door in the east wall hides a study, a small stairway
leads away south, and the grand staircase lies west.

8382.name: The Hidden Library

west.description: To the west lies The Hall Of Guests.

down.description: To the down lies A Secret Room.

8382.description:
Books crowd every wall of this low room, bound in cracked leather and
chained to their shelves. The dust lies thick except along one well-
trodden path to a reading desk. A lamp with a smoky glass hangs over
open pages written in a crabbed and unfamiliar hand. West is the Hall Of
Guests, and a trapdoor in the floor opens on a stair going down.

8383.name: A Secret Room

up.description: To the up lies The Hidden Library.

8383.description:
This tiny chamber was never meant to be found. Its walls are bare stone,
scrawled with diagrams of circles and stars in dried brown pigment. An
iron brazier stands cold at the centre, with a stool, a knife and a bowl
beside it as if the work were only paused. A ladder climbs up to the
library above.

extra_descs.diagrams circles stars pigment:
The diagrams are drawn in layer upon layer of brown pigment, each ring
crossing the last. At the centre of every one is the same small mark,
shaped like a closed eye.

8384.name: The Grand Staircase

south.description: To the south lies The Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies At The Grand Staircase.

8384.description:
You stand at the head of the grand staircase, where the black balustrade
curls round and ends in a snarling stone head. A worn carpet, once
crimson, runs along the landing in rags. Portraits of grim men and women
in antique dress hang above, their painted eyes oddly bright. Steps lead
down to the hall below, and the landing opens south into the upper
hallway.

8385.name: The Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Staircase.

east.description: To the east lies At The End Of The Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Hallway.

8385.description:
The upper hallway is a long gallery of black timber and stone, lit by
narrow slits that admit a sullen grey. A threadbare carpet runs the
length of the floor, worn through to bare boards at the centre. Shut
doors set into the walls turn out to be false panels of painted wood.
The grand staircase lies north, a short stub of hall ends east, and the
gallery stretches on west.

8386.name: At The End Of The Hallway

east.description: To the east lies A Guest Room.

west.description: To the west lies The Hallway.

8386.description:
The hallway ends in a blind wall hung with a cracked mirror whose glass
shows the corridor in a darker light. A tall candle stub sits in a
sconce, scabbed with old wax. The hall runs back west, and a door on the
east side leads into a guest room.

8387.name: A Guest Room

west.description: To the west lies At The End Of The Hallway.

8387.description:
A bed with black curtains stands in the middle of the guest room, the
sheets still turned down for a visitor long gone. A washstand with a
chipped basin sits by a slit window, and the water in it is stale and
brown. The wardrobe door hangs open on bare hooks. The only way out is
west into the hall.

8388.name: The Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies The Hallway.

8388.description:
The hallway turns here, and the old carpet gives way to bare flagstones
polished by generations of feet. Shields blackened beyond recognition
hang on the walls, each with a spearhead-shaped hole punched through the
boss. North the hall carries on, and east it returns toward the stair.

8389.name: The Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Hallway.

8389.description:
Narrow windows of cloudy glass line one wall, each smeared with soot on
the outside. Between them hang portraits so darkened that only the pale
shapes of faces remain. A draught moans along the corridor like someone
breathing through broken teeth. North the hall carries on, and south it
turns back.

8390.name: The Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies A Guest Room Filled With Death.

south.description: To the south lies The Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Guest Room On The Brink Of Hell.

8390.description:
Doors face each other across the hall here, heavy things of black oak
with iron studs. The one to the east is scored with deep scratches
around the latch, and the one to the west is warm to the touch, though
no fire burns near. The hallway continues north and south.

8391.name: The Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies A Guest Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Guest Room.

8391.description:
A tall candelabrum of black iron stands in the middle of the hall, its
cups full of cold tallow. An open archway on the west side gives onto a
dark chamber, while a closed door faces it on the east. The hallway runs
north and south from here, the carpet thin and rucked.

8392.name: The Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Balcony.

east.description: To the east lies The Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Hallway.

8392.description:
Cold air pours down the hall from the north, where a pair of glass doors
stand open onto a balcony. The sconces along the walls are gutted and
black, and the carpet is stiff with damp. A broader passage leads east
toward the court, and the hallway runs back south.

8393.name: The Balcony

south.description: To the south lies The Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies The Frozen Lake.

8393.description:
A narrow stone balcony juts from the castle wall, its parapet crumbling
and furred with lichen. Far below, a pale frozen lake lies in a hollow
of the hills, ringed by black rock and bare trees. A weathered iron
stair drops down toward the ice, and the wind tugs at your cloak. The
hallway lies back south.

8394.name: The Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Court Room.

west.description: To the west lies The Hallway.

8394.description:
The hallway broadens into a processional way of tall pillars and black
marble flags. Banners hang from iron arms, so heavy with dust that they
no longer stir. At the east end a pair of tall doors leads into the
court room, and the passage returns west toward the main gallery.

8395.name: The Court Room

east.description: To the east lies Before The Royal Chambers.

west.description: To the west lies The Hallway.

8395.description:
A long table covered in a black cloth stands at the head of the room,
with a high chair behind it and a low stool before. The benches for
onlookers are heaped with dust in grey drifts. Scorch marks and old
stains mark the flags in front of the table. Doors lead west to the
hallway and east before the royal chambers.

8396.name: Before The Royal Chambers

north.description: To the north lies The King's Chamber.

east.description: To the east lies The Secret Staircase.

south.description: To the south lies The Queen's Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Court Room.

8396.description:
A small antechamber of fine, cold stone lies between the royal rooms,
floored in black and white marble chequers. A statue of a hooded figure
stands in an alcove, hands cupped around nothing. The King's Chamber
lies north, the Queen's Chamber south, and the court room west, while a
narrow door set into the east wall is cut flush with the stone.

extra_descs.statue hooded figure alcove:
The statue is cut from a single block of black stone, its face hidden in
a deep hood. Its cupped hands are stained dark, as if something was once
poured into them.

8397.name: A Guest Room On The Brink Of Hell

east.description: To the east lies The Hallway.

8397.description:
Heat pours from the walls of this room as if a furnace burned in the
masonry. The plaster is blistered, the curtains scorched to black rags,
and the bed linen has crisped to brown flakes. A tarnished brazier at
the centre glows with no fuel in it. You can only retreat through the
door east.

8398.name: A Guest Room Filled With Death

west.description: To the west lies The Hallway.

8398.description:
The bed in this room is a ruin of splintered posts and torn hangings,
and dark stains have soaked into the boards underneath. Words are gouged
in the plaster in a frantic hand, all crossed out and rewritten. The air
hangs close and bitter. The way out is west.

8399.name: A Dark Guest Room

east.description: To the east lies The Hallway.

8399.description:
No window lights this guest room, and the lamp on the table is cold and
empty. Heavy curtains smother one wall, and under them the furniture is
no more than lumps of shadow. A faint smell of damp wool and candle
smoke clings to the air. The door east leads back to the hallway.

8401.name: A Guest Room

west.description: To the west lies The Hallway.

8401.description:
The guest room is spartan, with a hard cot, a chair and a rack of pegs
on bare plaster. A small barred window gives on a court fenced by black
walls. A rug of worn wool lies curled at the edges, and the bedclothes
smell of lamp-oil. The door west leads to the hallway.

8402.name: The Queen's Chamber

north.description: To the north lies Before The Royal Chambers.

8402.description:
A tall, narrow room hangs in ivory silk gone yellow, with a dressing
table crowded with cracked bottles and pots of dried paint. The bed is
made up in lace, though the pillow has long since stained brown. An
ebony casket stands open and empty at its foot. The only door lies
north.

8403.name: The King's Chamber

south.description: To the south lies Before The Royal Chambers.

8403.description:
A vast bed of black wood stands under a canopy of rotted velvet, its
posts carved with twisting runes. A tall mirror in a silver frame has
been turned to face the wall, and a great chest, locked and banded,
stands beside it. The air tastes of ash and cold iron. Heavy curtains
hide the tall windows and stir now and then, though there is no wind,
and the only door, of black iron, lies south.

extra_descs.curtains window windows: Heavy black curtains, rotted at the hems, cover windows tall enough for a man to step through. Something has torn small ragged holes in them, high up, as if with claws.
extra_descs.mirror: The mirror has been turned to face the wall. Whoever sleeps here has no wish to see what it would show, or what it would not.

8404.name: The Secret Staircase

west.description: To the west lies Before The Royal Chambers.

down.description: To the down lies The Secret Stairs.

8404.description:
A cramped landing behind a hidden door, little more than a ledge of
stone with a hole of steps beyond. Cobwebs clog the corner, and the
walls bear faint marks where hands have pressed through the dark. Cold
air pulses upward from below as if the castle were breathing. The royal
antechamber is west, and the staircase goes down.

8406.name: The Secret Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Secret Staircase.

down.description: To the down lies The Secret Stairs.

8406.description:
The secret stairs descend in a tight spiral, each step a wedge of black
stone barely wide enough for a foot. The ceiling presses low, and the
wall rubs the shoulder on one side. No torch has ever burned here, and
the dust underfoot lies undisturbed. The stairs lead up toward the
landing and down into deeper dark.

8407.name: The Secret Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Secret Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Secret Stairs.

8407.description:
A seam of white mineral veins the wall of the stair, glinting faintly
where it catches the light. The steps are worn from long use, though the
dust says no one has come lately. The air is dry and tastes of metal.
You can climb up or descend.

8408.name: The Secret Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Secret Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Secret Stairs.

8408.description:
Here the stair straightens into a long flight with a low arch overhead,
every block carved with a small sign of a closed eye. The lowest step of
the flight vanishes in shadow. A smell of old stone and cold ash settles
in the throat. The flight runs up and down.

8409.name: The Secret Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Secret Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Nether Vault.

8409.description:
The stairs end at a heavy landing of black slabs, where the air is
colder than a winter well. Rusted hinges show where a gate once stood,
now torn aside and left bent. The sound of your own breathing is the
only noise. The stair rises behind you, and steps descend into the
Nether Vault.

8410.name: The Nether Vault

east.description: To the east lies The Hall Of The Unliving.

up.description: To the up lies The Secret Stairs.

8410.description:
The vault is a broad chamber of black stone ribs rising to a dome lost
in the dark, its floor etched with a great circle of grey runes. The
cold is bitter, the silence absolute, and the runes seem to flicker when
you look away. Rows of urns stand along the walls, sealed with lead. The
stair leads up, and an arched opening leads east.

8411.name: The Hall Of The Unliving

west.description: To the west lies The Nether Vault.

down.description: To the down lies The Crypt Of The Vampire.

east.description: To the east lies The Ebon Hall.

8411.description:
Long rows of stone biers fill the hall, each bearing a robed figure laid
out as if for burial, hands crossed on rusted swords. Dust lies thick
over cloth and bone, yet the tracks in it are fresh. A damp smell of old
graves hangs in the air. The Nether Vault lies west, and a sloping ramp
descends into the crypt below.

8412.name: The Crypt Of The Vampire

up.description: To the up lies The Hall Of The Unliving.

down.description: To the down lies Below The Crypt.

8412.description:
A coffin of black wood stands on a dais at the centre of the crypt, its
lid carved with a bat-winged crest and its edges worn smooth by touch.
The walls are lined with bare shelves, as though the occupant had no use
for the dead of others. Candles burn in iron stands, though no hand
lights them. A ramp leads up to the hall above, and a ragged hole in the
floor gives on a way down.

extra_descs.coffin lid crest:
The lid bears a crest of spread bat wings above a drinking cup. The wood
is cold as stone, and no dust has settled on it in all the years of the
castle.

8413.name: The Frozen Lake

north.description: To the north lies At The Cave Entrance.

up.description: To the up lies The Balcony.

8413.description:
A broad sheet of grey ice lies beneath the castle's cliff, scoured clean
by the wind and veined with white cracks. Snow lies in drifts along the
margins, and black rock rises on every hand. A stair of rusted iron
climbs the cliff up to the balcony. A dark cleft opens in the rock face
to the north, where the ice runs to its edge.

8414.name: At The Cave Entrance

north.description: To the north lies A Cave Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Frozen Lake.

8414.description:
The rock face splits here into a ragged mouth, and the cold of the lake
gives way to a deeper chill. Icicles hang in rows from the lip of the
opening, and the floor is a slick of frost and grit. A faint odour of
rot drifts out of the dark. The way north leads into a tunnel, and the
lake lies south.

8415.name: A Cave Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Cave Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies At The Cave Entrance.

8415.description:
The tunnel is rough-hewn rock, barely wider than outstretched arms, its
walls glistening with wet. Old pick marks show where hands cut it, long
before the castle was finished. The floor slopes gently, and the sound
of dripping fills the dark. It runs north into deeper blackness and
south toward the pale light of the lake.

8416.name: A Cave Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Altar Room Of The Skinless Ones.

south.description: To the south lies A Cave Tunnel.

8416.description:
The tunnel bends sharply here, the rock rising into a low, rippled vault
stained red-brown. Something has been smeared on the walls in long hand-
wide streaks, and the dried marks flake like old rust. The reek of blood
is stronger in this place. A broader opening leads east, and the tunnel
runs back south.

8417.name: The Altar Room Of The Skinless Ones

west.description: To the west lies A Cave Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies The Six Thousand Stairs.

8417.description:
A stone altar slick with old gore fills the middle of this cavern,
ringed by crude pillars of piled rock. Hooks of bronze hang from the
roof on chains, and stained knives lie in niches cut in the wall. A worn
stair spirals into the floor at the far side. The tunnel lies west, and
the stair leads down.

8418.name: The Six Thousand Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Altar Room Of The Skinless Ones.

down.description: To the down lies The Six Thousand Stairs.

8418.description:
The stair begins as a chute cut straight into the rock, each step steep
and slick. The air grows colder with every pace, and the glow from the
altar room above dims quickly. Small handprints, many and many, mark the
wall where others steadied themselves. The stair climbs up to the altar
room and plunges down into the dark.

8419.name: The Six Thousand Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Six Thousand Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Six Thousand Stairs.

8419.description:
Steps hewn from raw rock curve slowly downward, their edges worn to
rounded lips. Water runs down the wall in thin threads and pools in the
hollows of the treads. Somewhere below, a slow rhythmic scraping can be
heard, and then silence. The stairs lead up and down.

8420.name: The Six Thousand Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Six Thousand Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Six Thousand Stairs.

8420.description:
Hundreds of steps lie behind you and no end can be seen ahead. A rope of
knotted hair, stiff with age, has been fixed along the rock as a
handrail. The stone sweats, and the air smells of wet earth and rust.
You can go up or down.

8421.name: The Six Thousand Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Six Thousand Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Six Thousand Stairs.

8421.description:
The staircase widens briefly into a landing hacked out of the rock, with
a tilted slab at one side where weary climbers might rest. Scratched
tallies cover the slab in groups of five, hundreds upon hundreds. The
cold here pricks like needles. The stair continues up and down from the
landing.

8422.name: The Six Thousand Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Six Thousand Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Cave Of Wailing.

8422.description:
A faint wailing climbs the stair from below, thin and unending, rising
and falling like wind in a flute. The steps here are cracked and
slanted, and some have fallen away to leave gaps over blackness. The
rock is slick with a bitter, greasy damp. The stairs run up, and down
toward the source of the sound.

8423.name: The Cave Of Wailing

north.description: To the north lies The House Of Death.

up.description: To the up lies The Six Thousand Stairs.

8423.description:
A wide cavern opens at the foot of the stairs, its roof lost in dark and
its floor strewn with bones. Wind gusting through unseen cracks makes a
wailing that never ceases. A heavy door of black iron stands in the far
wall. The stair climbs up behind you, and the door leads north to the
House Of Death.

extra_descs.bones floor:
The bones lie in drifts and heaps, human and otherwise, all gnawed clean
and snapped for the marrow. Nothing here has been buried.
extra_descs.door iron starred star: An iron door set into the rock of the north wall, a seven-pointed star worked into its face around the keyhole. It is warm to the touch, and through the keyhole comes a low hum and a breath of heat like an opened furnace. Whatever is chained behind it is far beyond the dead of this castle: go in with a great company at your back, or not at all.

8424.name: The House Of Death

south.description: To the south lies The Cave Of Wailing.

8424.description:
Niches line this long, low chamber, each cut for a body and most of them
filled with shapes wrapped in grey shrouds. The air is dry and hot, and
it hums, low, like a held note. Dust has settled on everything but a
ring of bare floor at the centre, where the stone has been scorched
smooth as glass. A single iron door, set with a seven-pointed star,
leads back south.

extra_descs.ring floor glass: The ring of floor is fused smooth, black glass shot through with veins of light that still move, slowly, like something breathing.
extra_descs.shrouds niches shapes bodies: The shrouded dead lie with their hands crossed over their chests. Each one holds something that was once a weapon, melted at the blade.

8426.name: Below The Crypt

south.description: To the south lies A Cave Room.

up.description: To the up lies The Crypt Of The Vampire.

8426.description:
The floor of the crypt gave way long ago, and this is what lay beneath:
a low space of broken masonry and raw rock, where tomb-slabs lie tilted
in the rubble. Bones of earlier burials poke from the walls. A cold wind
slides in from a passage south, and a steep rise leads up to the crypt.

8427.name: A Cave Room

north.description: To the north lies Below The Crypt.

south.description: To the south lies The Small Crevice.

8427.description:
The passage opens into a small cavern, its roof dripping and its floor a
litter of gravel and old droppings. Thin light creeps in from far off,
where the mountain lets a little daylight through a crack. The way south
squeezes into the crevice and out toward open country, while north a
rough passage leads back toward the crypts.

8450.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies In Spirit Wood.

8450.description:
Rough steps cut in the rock climb to a square opening overhead, where a
ladder of iron rungs leads up toward fresh air and the smell of leaf
mould. The hatch above has been forced open, its chain hanging slack.
The tunnel here tangles back on itself, three of its ways bending round
to the same junction. The only clear way onward leads south.

8451.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

8451.description:
The tunnel narrows into a crack where the walls squeeze the shoulders,
and the roof sags with fallen slabs. Pale roots hang through the rock
like grey fingers. A trickle of water slides down one wall. It leads
north toward the ladder and east deeper into the dark.

8452.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

8452.description:
The passage is smoother here, as if a river once scoured it, and the
floor is a bed of fine grey silt. Bare footprints are pressed into the
silt, all of them pointing the same way. The air is damp and tastes of
copper. The tunnel runs north, and returns west.

8453.name: The Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

8453.description:
A faint blue glow comes from patches of fungus on the roof, enough to
show the shapes of the rock but not to read by. The stone is warm and
furred with damp, and spores drift down like pale dust. The tunnel leads
east, and south it falls back.

8454.name: The Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

8454.description:
The tunnel bends hard around a pillar of unworked stone, as though the
diggers dared not remove it. Scratches circle the pillar at head height,
a spiral cut again and again. A cold wind breathes from the passage on
the far side of the bend. The way returns west, and runs on south.

extra_descs.pillar spiral scratches:
The scratches spiral upward in a hundred loops, each loop a little
tighter than the last. Whoever made them was counting something, and ran
out of wall.

8455.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

8455.description:
The floor is laid with flat slabs for a stretch, the only dressed stone
yet seen, and cart wheels have worn two deep grooves along it. Rusted
iron staples are driven into the wall at intervals to carry lanterns. It
runs straight north and south.

8456.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

8456.description:
A rockfall has half-choked the passage, leaving a rough slope of
boulders to scramble over. Between the stones, tufts of white bone dust
show where something was crushed long ago. The air is stale and silent,
and each step rattles loose pebbles. The way leads north back along the
straight, and west beyond the slope.

8457.name: The Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

8457.description:
Water has gathered across the floor in a shallow black pool, and the
roof drips into it with a slow plink. Stalactites hang overhead like
rows of teeth, some joined to the floor by thin pillars. The reek of
damp stone is thick. The tunnel runs east and west beyond the pool.

8458.name: The Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

8458.description:
The walls here are scorched dark, as if flame once roared through the
passage. Streaks of soot climb the roof, and a crust of fused rock lines
the floor. The air is dry and bitter on the tongue. The tunnel goes east
back along the passage and turns south.

8459.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

8459.description:
A low stretch breaks the tunnel, its roof so near the floor that you
must crawl in places. Names and dates are scratched at knee height on
the walls, the oldest worn almost smooth. A chill draught tugs from
further on. The way north leads back, and west the passage winds on.

8460.name: The Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

8460.description:
The tunnel drops through a rough stair of three steps and runs on
between walls hung with long ribbons of flowstone. A small shrine has
been scratched into one wall, a stick figure with a ring of dots about
its head. The floor is gritty with broken limestone, and the sound of
dripping comes from ahead. East lies the low crawl, and the way
continues south.

8461.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

8461.description:
A long straight run of tunnel, the walls regular enough to have been
dressed with tools. Lantern hooks of bronze stand every few paces, green
with verdigris. The dust underfoot has been scuffed into a clear lane by
passing feet. The tunnel leads north and south.

8462.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

8462.description:
The passage dips to a low, dark corner where the walls turn, and a pool
of stagnant water lies across the path. A pale film of fungus covers the
stones just above the waterline. The stink of rot is thick. The way
leads north, back up the straight run, and east round the bend.

8463.name: The Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

8463.description:
Carved on the walls in shallow relief are lines of warriors marching in
profile, shields overlapped, spears raised. The carving is crude but
powerful, and each warrior has a hollow where an eye should be. The
tunnel follows the procession west and east.

8464.name: The Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

8464.description:
The warriors give way to ships: long, snake-prowed hulls carved in rows
across the rock, oars raised like the legs of an insect. The cold has a
salt edge here, as if some sea stood just out of sight. A bend sends the
tunnel west and south.

8465.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

8465.description:
A pile of broken ox-bones and shattered cups lies heaped in a corner of
the passage, the remains of some feast set down in the dark. Old drips
of tallow cling to a ledge. The air is thick with a smell of cold smoke
and mead gone sour. The tunnel climbs north and goes on west.

8466.name: The Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

8466.description:
The tunnel opens into a bay of rock where three ways meet. On the wall a
rune has been cut as tall as a man, a jagged character of forked lines
packed with black pitch. Iron nails, long since headless, jut from the
stone in lines below it. The way west leads toward the tangled crossing,
east back along the ship carvings, and south toward a wider hall.

extra_descs.rune pitch character:
The rune is a fork of three lines splitting from one stem, packed with
pitch that still smells sharp. It looks like a warning, or a wolf's paw.

8467.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

8467.description:
Four passages meet in a ragged crossing, the rock between them
honeycombed with old niches. Chalk marks have been scrawled on the
walls, arrows and crosses overlapping until none can be trusted. Water
gathers in a shallow puddle at the centre. The ways lead north, east,
south and west, and each looks much the same as the others.

8468.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Guardians Hall.

8468.description:
The tunnel ends in a broad doorless arch, flanked by two great stone
pillars carved as bearded men, their eyes hollowed and their hands
clasped on sword hilts. A heavy cold stands in the air like a held
breath. The tunnel runs back north, and an arch south opens on the
Guardians Hall.

8469.name: The Guardians Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Hall Of Feast.

8469.description:
Rows of tall stone figures line this hall, armoured and bearded, each
guarding the empty air. Their faces are worn nearly smooth, their swords
chipped, and a skin of dust covers their shoulders. A pair of great oak
doors bound with bronze stands closed at the far end to the south, and
the tunnel lies north.

8470.name: A Hall Of Feast

north.description: To the north lies The Guardians Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Storage Room.

west.description: To the west lies Storage Room.

8470.description:
A long table of black oak runs down the middle of the hall, set with
horn cups and wooden platters laid out for a feast that never began. The
benches are cobwebbed, and a firepit of white ashes sits cold in the
floor. Smoke-stained shields cover the walls. Doors lead north to the
guardians, east into a passage, and storerooms stand south and west.

8471.name: Storage Room

east.description: To the east lies A Hall Of Feast.

8471.description:
This storeroom holds stacked sacks of grain long turned to black powder,
and a rack of drinking horns with their rims chewed away. Amphorae lie
broken and spilled, with dried wine staining the floor like old blood.
The air is dry and sour. The only way out is east to the feast hall.

8472.name: Storage Room

north.description: To the north lies A Hall Of Feast.

8472.description:
Barrels of salted meat, split open and long rotted, fill this storeroom
to the roof. Bundles of straw and bone clog the corners. A trestle with
a few blackened knives stands near the door. The only way out is north
to the feast hall.

8473.name: The Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Burial Room Of Fenrir.

west.description: To the west lies A Hall Of Feast.

8473.description:
A short stretch of passage links the feast hall and the burial chamber,
its walls hung with rotted skins and iron torch-rings. Carved horses and
wolves run along the stone, their eyes picked out with chips of amber.
The air tastes of dry earth and old death. West lies the hall, and a
bronze-bound door leads east.

8474.name: The Burial Room Of Fenrir

north.description: To the north lies The Northwest Corner Of The Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Southwest Corner Of The Room.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

8474.description:
A great barrow-chamber opens here, its roof held by timber pillars as
thick as oaks and carved with coiling beasts. The floor is hard-trodden
earth strewn with weapons, cups and rotted offerings, and fine dust
hangs in the air like smoke. The chamber stretches away north and south.
The door west leads back to the tunnel.

8475.name: The Northwest Corner Of The Room

east.description: To the east lies The Northeast Corner Of The Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Burial Room Of Fenrir.

8475.description:
In this corner of the chamber lie heaped shields, round and painted,
rotted so that only the iron bosses still gleam. A broken harp leans in
the angle of the timber wall. The earthen floor is spongy with age. The
chamber continues east along the wall and south toward the middle.

8476.name: The Northeast Corner Of The Room

south.description: To the south lies The Entrance To The Longboat.

west.description: To the west lies The Northwest Corner Of The Room.

8476.description:
Here stand rows of clay jars sealed with wax and sunk to their necks in
the earth, each one marked with a rune. Some have cracked and weep a
thick black residue. The timber wall is gnawed and splintered at its
foot. The wall runs west, and south the chamber slopes toward the
longboat.

8477.name: The Entrance To The Longboat

north.description: To the north lies The Northeast Corner Of The Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Southeast Corner Of The Room..

west.description: To the west lies The Restingplace Of Fenrir.

8477.description:
A ship's prow of blackened oak rears out of the earth, carved as a
snarling wolf head with fangs of whale-bone. The long boat itself is
sunk into the floor, its hull stretching away in darkness. A plank
gangway leads west into the hull, where the chieftain's resting place
lies. The chamber runs north and south along the ship's side.

extra_descs.prow wolf head figurehead:
The wolf's head is carved with astonishing skill, mouth open and brow
furrowed. Its eyes are set with black stones that seem to follow whoever
passes.

8478.name: The Southeast Corner Of The Room.

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance To The Longboat.

west.description: To the west lies The Southwest Corner Of The Room.

8478.description:
A heap of rusted spears and axe-heads lies against the timbers, bundled
with leather straps that crumble at a touch. The ship's stern post rises
beside them, carved with twisting knotwork. The soil has been churned
where something has been digging. The chamber leads north toward the
boat's prow and west along the wall.

8479.name: The Southwest Corner Of The Room

north.description: To the north lies The Burial Room Of Fenrir.

east.description: To the east lies The Southeast Corner Of The Room..

8479.description:
A line of pitted human skulls sits on a shelf of earth in this corner,
each wearing a ring of tarnished silver about the brow. Cold air sighs
from a crack in the timber wall. The dust is deep and hard-packed, as
though nobody has stirred it in an age. The chamber returns north to the
entrance and runs east beside the ship.

8480.name: The Restingplace Of Fenrir

east.description: To the east lies The Entrance To The Longboat.

8480.description:
The hull's inner chamber is a low timber cabin hung with sailcloth
rotted into black lace. In the middle lies a raised bier of oak, bearing
a great sword, a horned helm and a heap of bone long since gone to grey.
The air is bitter and the dark presses close. The gangway east returns
to the chamber.

8481.name: A Small Stairway

north.description: To the north lies The Castle Yard.

up.description: To the up lies A Small Stairway.

8481.description:
A narrow stairway of worn black steps winds up from a low door that
opens on the yard. Cold daylight spills through the archway, thinning to
nothing a few steps higher. The treads are crusted with dried mud and
straw carried in on stable boots. North the doorway gives onto the
castle yard, and the steps climb up into the dark.

8482.name: A Small Stairway

up.description: To the up lies A Dark Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies A Small Stairway.

8482.description:
The stair is no wider than a man's shoulders, spiralling tightly between
walls of sweating black stone. Each step is hollowed by feet, and a rope
rail, greasy with use, is the only help. Cold seeps from above, and the
smell of stable straw drifts up from below. You may climb on, or descend
toward the yard.

8483.name: A Dark Hallway

east.description: To the east lies A Dark Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies A Small Stairway.

8483.description:
No torch burns in this hallway, and the dark seems to have weight,
pressing on the eyes. The floor is bare boards, and the walls are
panelled in wood gone black with age and damp. A dry ticking sounds
somewhere inside the panelling and then stops. The hallway continues
east, and the stair descends behind you.

8484.name: A Dark Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Vampire Lounge.

east.description: To the east lies The Linen Closet.

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Hallway.

8484.description:
The hall widens into a dark crossing where three doorless openings meet.
Cobwebs hang from the beams in heavy grey curtains, and the boards groan
with each step. A sweet, cloying smell, like old flowers and cold wax,
drifts from the north. A narrow closet lies east, the hallway runs back
west, and a grander room waits north.

8485.name: The Linen Closet

west.description: To the west lies The Vampire Lounge.

8485.description:
Shelves of yellowed linen rise to the ceiling in this closet, folded
into squares as stiff as boards. A strange rust-brown stain spreads over
the lowest sheets. The cedar that once scented the cupboard is long
gone, replaced by a faint tang of iron. The only exit is west, back to
the lounge.

8486.name: The Vampire Lounge

south.description: To the south lies A Dark Hallway.

up.description: To the up lies The Attic.

8486.description:
Velvet couches the colour of dried blood crowd a lounge hung in black
drapes, and the air is heavy with the scent of old perfume. Dust lies on
everything but the cushions, which are crushed and hollowed as if lately
left. Cold ashes fill a marble hearth, and not a single window admits
any light. A hall lies south, and a ladder-stair climbs up to the attic.

8487.name: The Attic

down.description: To the down lies The Vampire Lounge.

8487.description:
Beneath the sloping beams, the attic is a jumble of broken furniture,
trunks and shrouded shapes. Dust-sheets cover things that seem too tall
and too narrow for chairs. Tiny slits in the roof let in threads of cold
light, and the floor creaks like an old ship. The only way out is the
hatch down to the lounge.

9149.name: A Barren Room

east.description: To the east lies The Guards' Quarters.

down.description: To the down lies A Cramped Stairway.

9149.description:
The room has been stripped to the walls: no bed, no table, only a bare
floor and a rusted ring in the ceiling. A trapdoor stands open in one
corner above a steep ladder of worn steps. The walls bear patches of
whitewash scored with thin lines. The way east returns to the guards'
quarters, and the stair goes down.

9150.name: A Cramped Stairway

north.description: To the north lies An Empty Corridor.

up.description: To the up lies A Barren Room.

9150.description:
The stair is so cramped that you must turn sideways to pass, and the
stone steps are scored by chain links. Mould coats the wall in black
velvet, and the air tastes of rust and old suffering. The steps climb up
into the barren room, and a low passage runs north from the bottom.

9151.name: An Empty Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Storage Room.

south.description: To the south lies A Cramped Stairway.

west.description: To the west lies The Prison.

9151.description:
The corridor is bare and echoing, lined with iron-banded doors set in
the stone. A gutter runs down the middle of the flags, rimmed with
brown. A row of empty hooks stands on the wall at head height. Doors
lead east to a storage room and west to the prison, and the stair lies
south.

9152.name: A Storage Room

west.description: To the west lies An Empty Corridor.

9152.description:
Barrels, crates and sacks are heaped to the roof in this storeroom, most
of them rotted open and spilling black meal. Coils of rope and rusted
fetters hang from nails by the door. A heap of mouldy blankets sits in a
corner, ruffled as if lately slept in. The door west leads back to the
corridor.

9153.name: The Prison

east.description: To the east lies An Empty Corridor.

9153.description:
A row of narrow cells lines the room, each with a stone shelf for a bed
and a ring set in the floor. The iron bars are thick with rust, and the
straw in every cell is old and black. Writing in blood and charcoal
covers the walls, and the scent of fear is ground into the very stone.
The door east leads out to the corridor.

9154.name: The Ebon Hall

south.description: To the south lies The Crypt Of The Vampire.

west.description: To the west lies The Hall Of The Unliving.

9154.description:
A hall of polished ebon stone stretches away, its pillars rising into a
ceiling of unbroken shadow. Black glass lamps burn with a cold white
flame, and the floor shows your reflection, long and wavering. At the
far end a high seat stands on a dais of nine steps. The only way out is
a stair leading south toward the vampire's resting place.

647000.name: castle guard soldier
647000.long_desc: A black-cloaked castle guard stands watch here, one gauntlet resting on his sword.
647000.description:
A hard-faced soldier in a coat of dark mail, the badge of Castle N'Kai
stitched on his cloak. His eyes are bloodshot from long watches, and he
looks at strangers as one looks at a rat in the larder.

647001.name: pale tunnel spider
647001.long_desc: A pale tunnel spider clings to the rock, its fat body twitching as it senses you.
647001.description:
A spider the size of a hound, bone-white from a life without light. Its
legs end in hooked claws that click on the stone, and its eight blind
eyes are milky and wet.

647002.name: barrow skeleton warrior bones
647002.long_desc: A barrow skeleton rattles here, hung with scraps of mail and clutching a notched blade.
647002.description:
A tall skeleton held together by dark sinew and bad magic. Rags of
rotted mail dangle from its ribs, and a cold green spark burns deep in
each eye socket.

647003.name: skinless cultist flayer
647003.long_desc: A skinless cultist crouches here, red muscle glistening in the dark as he murmurs a prayer.
647003.description:
A gaunt figure whose skin has been peeled away in ritual, leaving raw
red flesh bound in wet linen. He chants in a low whisper, and his hands
are never far from the curved blade at his belt.

647004.name: draugr house carl warrior
647004.long_desc: A draugr house-carl stalks the barrow, its grey hide stretched tight over bulging bones.
647004.description:
A hulking corpse in the rotted mail of the old north, its skin grey and
swollen like drowned leather. It guards its chieftain's rest with a
hatred that death has not dulled.

647005.name: fenrir wolf jarl draugr chieftain
647005.long_desc: Fenrir the Wolf-Jarl sits upright on his bier, a dead king with burning eyes and a great axe across his knees.
647005.description:
The long-dead chieftain of a northern host, huge even in death, with a
braided beard stiff as wire and a horned helm sunk over his brow. Frost
clings to his mail, and his eyes burn with a pale, hungry fire.

647006.name: ostragoth vampire lord sorcerer
647006.long_desc: Ostragoth the vampire lord stands before the shrouded bed, his cloak spread like folded wings.
647006.description:
A tall, hollow-cheeked man in robes the colour of a starless night, his
face like old parchment drawn tight over the bone. His lips are dark
with old blood, and when he smiles the teeth are long and white. The
black fire he once coiled about his fingers burns in his eyes now, two
cold points of light, and the air tastes of ash and iron whenever he
moves.

747000.name: dented castle helm iron
747000.room_desc: A dented iron helm lies here, stamped with a black tower.
747000.description: A plain iron helm stamped with the badge of Castle N'Kai. The brow is dented where a blow once rang it, and the padding smells of old sweat.

747001.name: flayer curved knife blade
747001.room_desc: A curved knife with a stained bone handle lies here.
747001.description: A narrow, hooked blade used for the rites of the Skinless Ones. The edge is whetted fine, and the handle of yellow bone is dark with old stains.

747002.name: fenrir bearded axe
747002.short_desc: a bearded axe of the old north
747002.room_desc: A heavy bearded axe lies here, runes cut into its blade.
747002.description: A broad axe with a hooked beard, its blade pitted with age and incised with wolf-runes. The haft is dark ash bound with greasy leather.

747003.name: ostragoth black glass staff
747003.room_desc: A staff of smooth black glass lies here, cold to the eye.
747003.description: A seven-foot staff of black volcanic glass, polished to a mirror and capped with a silver claw. Light seems to sink into it, and it hums faintly in the hand.

747004.name: ostragoth night mantle cloak
747004.room_desc: A mantle of night-black silk lies here, heavy and cool.
747004.description: A mantle of silk so dark it seems to drink the light, lined in grey fur and clasped with a silver brooch in the shape of a closed eye. It is warm only where it touches you.
